title: CacWare
features:
CacWare is a universal hub built for reliability, performance, and wide game support. Designed and developed solo from the ground up, as it is mostly a passion project, it focuses on consistency across multiple experiences while keeping gameplay smooth. 

Key points:

- Multi-game support (tons more games coming as well)
- Stable and optimized code
- Clean, responsive UI (Fluent Lib)
- Frequent updates and fixes
- Lightweight design
- Most Executors Supported

Updates and improvements are ongoing. Feedback is welcome. 
You can make game/features suggestions in the discord server.
